name: OpenAlgo
description: Your OpenAlgo deployment in OpenTrader: the market segments of your account (NSE, BSE, NFO, MCX…) on the charts and its trading from the charts.

settings.label: OpenAlgo API URL
settings.help: The base URL of your OpenAlgo server (REST).

settings.label: OpenAlgo WebSocket URL
settings.help: The full WebSocket URL of your OpenAlgo server, including any path (e.g. wss://your-domain/ws).

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Your OpenAlgo API key. Kept in the plugin's settings; never printed to the log.

settings.label: Exchanges to serve
settings.help: Comma-separated, the OpenAlgo segments exactly as their names appear in the instrument master (the index segments included: NSE_INDEX etc.). Symbols of other exchanges are not served; remove one your broker does not support.

settings.label: History request cap — minutes (days)
settings.help: The days of history one /history request may span for the minute tables. Your deployment serves 30; if that changes, set it here and long windows re-chunk accordingly. A blank or bad value keeps 30.

settings.label: History request cap — seconds (days)
settings.help: The days of history one /history request may span for the seconds tables (about 3 here). A blank or bad value keeps 3.

settings.label: History request cap — day charts (days)
settings.help: The days of history one /history request may span for the day, week and month tables. A blank or bad value keeps 365.

settings.label: Default product
settings.help: The product type an order starts from — the order ticket picks one per order (per segment: MIS or CNC on an equity, MIS or NRML on a derivative) and remembers the last pick.
